unit_verified: six-state fence contract; only clear passes
late clear beyond declared deadline is downgraded to timeout
degraded warning text for unavailable / timeout / malformed
micro move geometry relative to heading, vertical delta on relative height
point flight target geometry and height datum consistency
orbit 36 segments + closing edge, ring points on the requested radius
radius, coordinate and altitude out of range rejected
fake_transport_only: polyline shape validation and per-call deadline forwarding
segment count / snapshot echo / scope validation of the fence response
platform executor preview and confirm both check; blocked withdraws the card
orbit confirmation card states the radius semantic difference
simulator_only: blocked at confirm withdraws the pending card
degraded fence still requires control and confirmation
pose change invalidates the path confirmation card
not_verified_real_platform: the altitude datum of that endpoint
converge=ln_outside semantics and the structure of invalid[]
a fence data version field (does not exist in the current contract)
binding between static annotation resolution and the flight target point
not_verified_real_device: real obstacle avoidance, altitude limiting, no-fly detection or device motion

known_limits: DNS resolution is not bounded by the socket timeout; no thread is created to work around it
an uncancellable transport can only have its result discarded, never pre-empted
orbit point source labels (old/new) are this repo's usage, not a verified platform requirement
untouched: no MQTT, no real drone, no shared test/uat/prod service
no change to the action registry or the preview/confirm/execute chain
